name: Ancient World Boss: The Forgotten Giant
balanceNotes: one deity vs many — world boss scale
visualDescription: Colossal ancient titan of forgotten memory, hundreds of feet tall, eroded mythic stone and rusted plate armor fused with flesh, faceless helm cracked open revealing void-fog, shattered crown of broken Gate stones, massive corroded war-sword embedded in earth, ash falling upward, moss and Gate-vine growth on lower body.

aiProfile.counterplayWindow: World boss telegraph windows are longer than standard enemies but deal massive damage if not avoided.
